title: Record the odd-kernel coefficient-bit tariff
body:
## Summary
- On the named coefficient-bit tariff, each kernel in `{3, 5, 7, 9, 15}` strictly exceeds the dyadic fused bill and the dyadic baseline bill at every `j` from 0 through 32. That is 165 comparisons on each bill.
- The smallest fused margin is 14, at kernel 3 and `j = 0`. The word cost is not monotone: the costs of powers 4, 2, and 1 are 32, 38, and 45. The selected kappa is unchanged.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The comparison stops at `j = 32`.
